speak.title: Role-play: let the chatbot decide?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the person with two job offers
a.text: You have two job offers and cannot choose. You want to ask a chatbot to decide for you. Explain why you think it is a good idea. Listen to your friend's worries.

b.text: You think your friend should not let a chatbot choose. Ask questions about the jobs. Suggest a better way to use the chatbot, and say who should make the final decision.

phrases: I'm thinking of asking a chatbot to decide.
That's a big decision, so I wouldn't let it choose.
It could help you make a list of questions.
I'd still check the facts myself.
Let's agree that the final choice is yours.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did your friend change your mind, and who should make the final decision?
